headline: Ocean-freight stress is HIGH and rising — 42.0/100; Strait of Hormuz is the lead driver, -88% vs normal

bullets.text: Global Ocean Freight Stress is **42.0/100** (**high**), up 1.1 pts week-over-week. 3 of 28 monitored chokepoints are disrupted.
The biggest driver is **Strait of Hormuz**, running **10.0/day** vs a normal of **82.0/day** (-88%) — a sustained level shift, not a fresh blip.
Tracking **10** active disruptions (timeline baseline established this run).
Also moving now: **Bosporus Strait** is running **35% below** normal and **Mindoro Strait** is **59% above** normal (a diversion/reroute signal).
Against the loaded sample trade book, **$259.5M** routes through disrupted lanes — an estimated **$719K** cost-of-delay ($384K–$1.1M).
